mapper.select: SELECT timeline_seq AS timeline_seq, timeline_type_cd AS timeline_type_cd, title AS title, content AS content, TO_CHAR(event_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS event_dt, COALESCE(use_yn, 'Y') AS use_yn, TO_CHAR(updated_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS updated_at, updated_by AS updated_by, TO_CHAR(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS created_at, created_by AS created_by FROM adm_timeline_mst WHERE timeline_seq = #{timelineSeq}
mapper.insert:
SELECT nextval('adm_timeline_mst_seq')
